Level at Athlone Downstream:
Gauge is downstream of Athlone Weir and is a measure of the water level at the north end of
the callows south of Athlone.
Note: All sluices at Athlone Weir closed as of 17/10/2022
Discharge at Parteen Weir:
It is expected that a discharge ranging between 55 and 170m3/s will be necessary at
Parteen Weir over the next 5 days based on current weather forecast.
